manifest.title: SSB Room
manifest.description: Host a Scuttlebutt room for Manyverse and other Rooms 2 clients. Manage invitations, members, privacy and aliases in the browser.

SSB_PORT.title: SSB connections
SSB_PORT.description: Public TCP port for Scuttlebutt clients. If disabled, the room uses secure WebSockets on its HTTPS domain.

manifest.postInstallMessage:
1. Open this app’s **Web Terminal** in Cloudron and run `/app/code/room-admin`. Enter your public SSB ID from your Manyverse profile and choose a web password.
2. Open the app, choose **Sign in → Password sign-in**, and use the same SSB ID and password.
3. Open **Invites** in the room dashboard and create your first invite.
manifest.changelog:
* First Cloudron Community App release.
* Supports custom SSB ports, secure WebSockets, and Cloudron-managed SQLite backups.
* Adds guided admin setup and a simpler Manyverse invitation flow.

manifest.changelog:
* Default to secure WebSockets over port 443 for new dashboard installations, including behind Cloudflare.
* Direct SSB TCP remains available as an optional port binding.
